channel.title: North Bay Nugget - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Bay Nugget (nugget.ca)

item.title: Close but no cigar for the slumping North Bay Battalion as they lose 4-3 in Windsor
item.description: Losers of three straight, it gets no easier for North Bay on Friday night with a date against the London Knights. North Bay did beat the Knights at home on November 20

item.title: Official count of Nipissing homeless pop. is 452, but is likely more
item.description: At first glance, it looks like the homeless population has shrunk since last year, but count didn't capture 'hidden homeless.'

item.title: AI investing becoming more cautious against uncertainty
item.description: Markets are becoming more discerning, favoring companies that can demonstrate tangible returns on AI spending, alongside durable cash flows.

item.title: Northlander getting even closer to riding the rails of Northern Ontario after Friday announcement
item.description: The Northlander will span 740 kilometres between Toronto and Timmins, with a rail connection to Cochrane, for a total of 16 stops

item.title: Feral and stray cats becoming major problem in Bonfield
item.description: Council is hosting a public meeting to hear ideas on how best to manage the growing problem

item.title: Chris Sluman's leukemia battle continues but he has some expert help
item.description: Chris Sluman's fight against acute lymphoblastic leukemia continues and he's getting support from far and wide including his sister-in-law who is a US-based pediatric oncologist

item.title: Powassan Voodoos did some 'Rock' blasting on Friday night at the Sportsplex
item.description: Dylan Rousselle scored three times and added an assist in the Voodoos impressive home ice win over Timmins

item.title: North Bay Battalion beat the Knights in London in a dramatic win
item.description: In a gutsy effort, the Battalion took it to London, tying it late and winning in a shootout to and a three-game losing streak
